title: Infrastructure & Compute Radar
description: Host CPU, memory pressure, and enterprise storage IOPS saturation

panels.title: Average Host CPU Utilization
panels.query: metrics where metric = "system.cpu.utilization" | avg(value) by component every 5m since 12h

panels.title: Average Host Memory Utilization
panels.query: metrics where metric = "system.memory.utilization" | avg(value) by component every 5m since 12h
